status: DRAFT - synthetic references with author-written expectations, NOT reviewed by a librarian or faculty
provenance: Every reference below is invented for testing (invented authors, 'Example' publishers, a DOI in the reserved example range); none is a real work. The expectations apply the APA 7 rules as the assistant understands them and must be confirmed. Italics cannot be checked in plain text and are not part of any expectation.
